newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar slightly lower, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar slightly lower, trade dull.

text.p: White sugar futures took their cue from a bearish performance on the New York raws market on Tuesday afternoon, but overall volume and price movements remained thin, traders said.

Ranges reached no more than $1.80 and the key nearby positions drifted up from their session lows in reaction to the weak raws. Earlier, trade house purchases were reported to be offsetting commission house sales.
At 1730 GMT December stood 40 cents lower at $314.30 and the second-month March contract, where the bulk of the open interest lies, was 90 cents lower at $310.30. Volume was 1,276 lots.

Technical analysts pegged December's support at $310.00 after the erstwhile $315.00 level was broken during Monday's session, but added that the relative strength indicator (RSI) could also bounce higher as it hovered in oversold territory.
"The RSI is now due a bounce and a correction higher may now occur," said Darren Gurner, a technical analyst at Sucden.
"The break of this major support ($315) now sets up the next major level at $310 to be tested and this level could be tested in a short space of time," he said.
Turnover was similar on the Paris market, where movements were similar to London. December was $1.30 lower at $313.50 and March was down $2.50 at $310.50. Volume was 1,294 lots.
